terms.title: 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K
terms.summary: Reports US public companies must file with the SEC. A 10-K is the audited annual report, a 10-Q the quarterly report, and an 8-K a notice of a major event such as results, a merger or a leadership change.

terms.title: Market hours
terms.summary: The times an exchange is open for regular trading. US stock exchanges open 9:30 am to 4 pm New York time on weekdays. Crypto trades around the clock, and currencies trade around the clock on weekdays.

terms.title: Volume
terms.summary: How many shares or contracts changed hands in a period. A move on heavy volume is often read as broader participation than the same move on light volume.

terms.title: Drawdown
terms.summary: The fall from a peak to a later low, usually shown as a percent. It describes how deep a decline went, not whether it will recover.
